intended_service.value: Infineum D3354 is a performance package designed to meet API CG-4/CF-4/CF/SJ, MB p228.1/3 (package approved) performance level with Infineum SV261. Infineum D3354 can also be rationalised up to API CI-4/SL, ACEA E7, MB p228.3 using appropriate boosters.

limits: Max storage temperature is 60°C with maximum transfer temperature being 65°C.

open_questions: Claim type 'other': Infineum performance tables list 'Performance Level' per grade and mass % without approval/meets wording beyond the description.
Row 2 level is printed as 'As below plus Volvo VDS-2' (DL2-10203.pdf p.1); the reference ('below' vs the row above) is unclear.
Booster rows: footnotes 3 and 4 give three alternative boosters 'tuned for different base stock qualities'; all recorded as co-components. SV261 VM dose not printed.
